data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Diena is the personification of the day. The name is derived from the Greek word 'diena,' which means 'day.' Diena represents the sun and is often associated with new beginnings, renewal, and fresh starts. The name Diena carries the meaning “Goddess of the day” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Diena usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the day and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Δινα
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Δινα σημαίνει κρίσις ή δικαία
